label: A short window given for a major revival and the greatest harvest
description: A limited window given for a major revival and the greatest harvest of souls the world has seen, put at three years on 2 September 2025, prayed for as three and a half years on 9 October 2025, and described on 8 January 2026 as just a short little window opening after the house of America is cleaned. The window is stated without a start date, so it cannot be scored on its own.
